senses: to speak, declare, converse, command, promise, warn, threaten, sing
(Niphal) to speak with one another, talk
(Hiphil) to lead away, put to flight

strongs.def: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
strongs.kjv: answer, appoint, bid, command, commune, declare, destroy, give, name, promise, pronounce, rehearse, say, speak, be spokesman, subdue, talk, teach, tell, think, use (entreaties), utter, [idiom] well, [idiom] work
